newsitem.title: GREECE: OLYMPICS - ATHENS IN GROUP OF FIVE CITIES FOR 2004 GAMES.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS - ATHENS IN GROUP OF FIVE CITIES FOR 2004 GAMES.

text.p: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) announced Athens, Rome, Buenos Aires, Cape Town and Stockholm as the final five candidates to host the 2004 Summer Games.
The cities, chosen from 11 candidates, will now go forward to a vote of the full IOC session on September 5 when the venue for the Games will be decided.
The other candidates -- Istanbul, Lille, Rio de Janeiro, San Juan, Seville and St Petersburg -- were regarded as having weaker bids and were eliminated from the selection process.
An IOC selection college made the decision after studying a detailed technical report of each bid and hearing presentations from all 11 candidates on Thursday.
